pre_mortem: It's Monday and Benson under lost because the 69-yard game was a role, not a fluke: Conner stayed inefficient (2.97 YPC), Arizona gave Benson 12-15 carries, and one outside run cleared 10+ against a SEA front with only a 3-game sample (2 explosives allowed). Mafe sat and the ARI OL cluster all played, so lanes were cleaner than the 3.32 YPC figure. A half-yard edge at the median also loses to any book juice we never saw. The same Monday, a JSN over would have lost if SEA led and ran, which is why that lean was not forced onto this slip.
slip_story: Single leg, not a 3-4 leg parlay: SEA run-front suppression versus an ARI change-of-pace back. Do not add Conner under (counter-case stronger), Walker over (needs Charbonnet out and a lead), or JSN/Kupp overs (need the pass-funnel flip). No TDs, one market.
